# fastf 3.1.4 — nothing internal in your tab-complete

A follow-up to 3.1.3, which moved fastf's "this run is the one I opened a window
for" marker onto the rerun's own command line as a `--relaunched` flag.

Declaring that flag as a hidden argument kept it out of `fastf --help` and out of
the man pages, but not out of the **generated shell completions**: `fastf --<TAB>`
offered it in bash, zsh and fish. It is fastf's own bookkeeping and none of a
user's business, so it is no longer declared at all — fastf takes it off its own
command line before the argument parser ever sees it. It exists on no surface you
can read, and typing it anywhere except where the relaunch puts it is refused
like any other unknown flag.

## Upgrading

Install 3.1.4. The completions are regenerated by the package.
